name: Thats It
description: That's It! is a western domino game played with a double-15 set, providing a very large tile pool for longer sessions and larger tables. Players use standard matching placements while managing mobility and pip exposure with higher-number tiles that increase blocking complexity and swingy end control.

content.text: That's It! is a western domino game played with a double-15 set, providing a very large tile pool for longer sessions and larger tables. Players use standard matching placements while managing mobility and pip exposure with higher-number tiles that increase blocking complexity and swingy end control.
Double-15 domino games are encountered as modern North American-style expansions that use very large domino sets for long sessions and larger groups.
Domino set and optional score tracking by match profile.
Deal tiles by player count; remaining tiles form a boneyard if the profile uses draws.
